question: The passage suggests that to protect public health, it is essential to:

options.text: Ensure equitable access and clear communication

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes that universal immunization campaigns have been successful due to accessibility (cold-chain logistics, solar-powered refrigerators) and clear communication (door-to-door education, public awareness campaigns).
 
• Herd immunity is hindered by vaccine hesitancy, which can be overcome by educating the public through media and community initiatives.
 
• Hence, protecting public health requires equitable access to vaccines and transparent, open communication to maintain public trust in science.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Eliminate door-to-door visits – Incorrect; the passage highlights door-to-door interactions as crucial for educating households. (गलत)
 
• **Option 2:** Halt solar-powered technology – Incorrect; solar-powered refrigerators are vital for vaccine storage in remote locations. (गलत)
 
• **Option 4:** Focus solely on urban areas – Incorrect; the passage stresses the need for accessibility in remote locations as well, not just urban areas. (गलत)
